![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

The `renderReadiness` function is called inside a loop over all `sourceRows` (which contains hundreds of elements). Currently, it builds three Map indexes using `indexBy` on every single iteration. This results in an O(N * M) complexity and unnecessary memory allocation.

To optimize this to O(N + M), we should build these indexes once outside the loop in `buildManifest` and pass them as arguments to `renderReadiness`.

```suggestion
function renderReadiness(row, pageRendersById, mappingsByRowId, mappingsByQuestionKey) {
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. Optimize linear scans in array filtering by mapping lookup keys to a Set beforehand to reduce complexity from O(N * M) to O(N + M), ensuring existing classification behavior is preserved.
</details>

Fixed in 5df07ef20cbdd411dbc56b8a0fc8f27d96fcb1f6. `buildManifest` now prebuilds `pageRendersById`, `mappingsByRowId`, and `mappingsByQuestionKey` once, and passes those maps into `renderReadiness`, so the scheduler no longer rebuilds these indexes per source row. Focused verification passed, including artifact `--check` with unchanged manifest/readback hashes.

Fixed in 5df07ef20cbdd411dbc56b8a0fc8f27d96fcb1f6. The render/mapping indexes are now constructed once before the sourceRows loop and reused for each renderReadiness call. Focused verification passed and artifacts still match.
